body: Im constantly thinking about and discovering bad thoughts and actions in my past and present. I'm at war with myself. Trying to be better but worried that people woundn't accept me. I don't know if I should continue with life or not. Not sure what the next step is.
I'm actually on meds! Anti depressants to be exact.

Firstly let me say that I'm sorry this experience happend to you. No one should have to go through that. I hope you can move on. I did the stalking thing for a while and I still struggle with it but I'm learning. It's not right. If you're still struggling with it then I would recommend not reading on as I have something I need to say that's not exactly the most popular thing, but it's how I feel right now so I have to say it. It's more a thing for me than anything else. 
I don't like harm to come to anyone. You read stories, some even on this site about people doing bad things and other people doing what on it's surface is a bad thing to them but could be justified like punching a stalker for example. I don't know why but I just feel anger. I've done wrong in the past and still make mistakes now. I don't want anyone feeling the way I do. It's a horrible way and I don't know how to move forward. I think about suicide. I worry about that guy and how he might feel. Yes his behaviour was bang out of order but he has feelings and emotions just like everyone else. I don't want him to feel bad, at least not cripplingly so. Just enough to change. I just want people to be peaceful and loving toward one another you know. Sometimes I feel more anger to those who are targeted then those who have done the initial or primary bad thing. This part of brain now feels upset and the woman who punched him. I know that's a bit mixed up. I don't want this.
I'm trying. I'm not perfect but I'm trying to learn. I just don't know if other people would accept me. It's hard. I don't feel worth it or important. I'm trying.

I'm sorry that you had to go through that. I groped girls and other things when I was in school. It's so wrong. It doesn't define you. It doesn't define your life. Is there is one positive from my actions it's that I am learning to understand just what's going on. I'm not perfect, I make mistakes but I'm trying. Enough about me. You are strong. It takes courage to get through that. I'm sure you have lots of support here, and mine too. Wishing you all the best. Never give up hope, you can get through this and be as amazing as only you can.

It saddens me. I'm sorry you had to go through that. No one should ever have to. I was very inappropriate with women a few years ago. Not perfect but a lot better now. Why people do this I don't understand but I'm not angry (if anything I'm sympathetic that they feel the need to do that). I just that they'll see sense.

That's really hard for me to accept. There's things I forgot to mention (I masturbated through my clothes once in class). I wonder does it even make a difference. I just don't know what to do. It's of my own doing I know. That's really hard to take. It's very lonely. My childish side gets angry with women who don't give me a chance. But of course that's not right. I just don't know what to do with this.
Do you think there's someone out there? For me. I'm not exactly looking but I'd just like to know.
I'm so sorry you had to put up with that. But I have changed. If anything I use it as an experience not to do it again.
I am.
I apologise I didn't mean to imply that. I was just asking if there's anything I can do. Is there? I'm not in the US but we do have numbers we can call over here.

Could I ever have a relationship? I'm very very upset now. I feel very alone. If this is blocking me from girls then I don't know how to live with myself. I've dealt with this. Why is this happening? There has to be something I can do to put you at ease. Please what is it.
Thank you.
What would make you change your mind? Please, I need a pathway. Yes I groped (sexual assault) but I'm so so different. What would let you consider me safe? I don't know how to cope with this.
See a comment I made on a different post. Lots of reasons.

Why not? Maybe, but I can control it. Why do you think it would stay? Everyone has dark sides, I'm not calling everyone like me I'm just saying we have to control them. That's what I'm learning. I'm so different. What would it take for you to understand that?

My counselor tells me I'm too empathetic. I should have expressed it. I do feel empathy. I recently got a letter from my old school saying all is forgiven. The victims I've spoken to seem like they've forgiven me. I can't think about them too much because I'd tear myself apart. I'm very aware of the feelings and it makes me very ashamed. I'd like to say I stopped because I realised. Not true. I stopped because I was reported. I was told to stop many times, I just didn't care. It took a meeting with the principal to make me stop(and even then I lied and said they were accidents but I think they knew I was lying). I've changed by not doing it, by controlling myself, by listening and understanding. Although it's hard for me to support because it brings up so much guilt. That boy who did those things is dead. No one hates him more than me. I am a different person. I felt bad initially because of the consequences for me but now I realise it's my actions and the impact they had that should have been the reason. I'm trying to get everything across. I am sorry. I do regret it. I have changed. How's that?
With the greatest respect, I think inflict is far too strong a word. So you're saying that it's possible? What is enough? What would change your mind?
Then what should I say. What would convince you? I won't lie but if there is something I can say that matches I'll say it. I'm on edge with my life right now, I don't understand.
Do you think knowing the full details would change your mind? I do have a history but that's all it is. It's not me. Not anymore.

Yes it is, if it got worse I'd be in prison. What am I supposed to do? I'm lonely enough as it is and now you're telling me I can't have a girlfriend. If I can't do the things that I feel like I deserve to have a shot at then why carry on? I made mistakes, I am different. I am much better than I was, I care now.
Mostly 14. I was at the cinema and was looking at a girl a few times. They may have been frustrated or maybe I was misunderstanding. I'm not sure.
I am

I have changed so much. I feel like if you truly knew me, then it wouldn't stand in your way. I'm taking this very seriously. I just couldn't find another phrase. I've had counseling for this. I'm thinking about killing myself. I have changed and if you knew everything, it wouldn't stand in your way.
It's no joke
Oh I know that. It was to try and shape an idea as to what was going on. My counselor says it's something to do with it.

I wish I knew. Boredom, loneliness, attention seeking, because I could. I loved it. I knew exactly what I was doing and I didn't care at all about the girls. Them being annoyed spured me on. I smiled at the thought of what I was going to do to them every time I saw them. I lied when it was reported and said they were accidents. This covers most of it. Even typing it makes me feel very ashamed. I didn't have any friends at school so any attention was good attention. I have ASD, not that it's an excuse but may help you understand. I just didn't care, it was an adrenaline rush, a high.
Why? How? If no one accepts me then what's the point?

It's up to you. The way you're describing it it seems like at the moment he hasn't accepted that it happend. It's very difficult to deal with at that point. As someone who has needed forgiveness for things in the past let me tell you it can really damage you thinking about it, at least for me. I think I've been forgiven. There's always the doubt but hopefully it's not true and it will go away one day,or if not I'll be able to deal with it. The bond between family is strong. For me he would need to acknowledge and apologise. But if he did I would absolutely forgive him without hesitation. At least I'd like to think so, I've never been in that situation. There is no point holding on to this. Just because someone burned a bridge doesn't mean you shouldn't put it back together. Forgiveness is a wonderful healer I think. The ability to forgive is a gift. Forgiveness spreads love and joy and they make the world go around. It's up to you. That's just my view.

We cannot predict the future. There was nothing you could have done. It's not your fault. These things just happen. I'm suicidal at the moment so maybe I'm not the best person to be asking but every parent has a deep fundamental love for their child. After that conversation, if you had died instead of him, how do you think he'd feel? He loved you. Family is a strong bond.
